pages.learnerAction: Listen to the can-do, then read the exact lesson title “One thing you would change about your work or school” aloud once.

pages.learnerAction: Ask any question left from pre-study; otherwise continue directly to the live discussion.

pages.learningTarget: Use the 10-claim pre-study article to seed concrete language and viewpoints for “One thing you would change about your work or school.”

pages.failureDiagnosis: No article question is not a failure; difficulty with a selectively glossed item identifies a local vocabulary-support need.
pages.nonTargetSupport: All ten claims have aligned full-specific Japanese support; selective owned glosses are: unintended effect=予期しない影響.

pages.choiceQuality: Sentence reveals provide optional bilingual support and selective glosses; they are not graded choices or distractors.
pages.componentConsistency: Uses the approved ten-row sentence-reveal article with one operating question and the tutor-only skip rule.

pages.learnerAction: Listen to how the eight-question pool for “One thing you would change about your work or school” will be used, then begin the conversation.

pages.failureDiagnosis: No language failure is tested; an interview-like checklist flow would show that the operating note was not followed.
